claim: Accuracy on retrieving the latest value of a key falls steeply (roughly log-linear, then collapse) as superseded similar values accumulate in context, across dozens of LLMs.
agent_test: Same-key update stream at equal tokens: sweep superseded versions 3..300, compare with and without pruning of superseded entries.

claim: Errors under proactive interference are mostly same-key intrusions of old values (56.1% of PI errors) or retrieval failure (42.5%), not hallucination (0.2-0.9%).
agent_test: Log error type on agent memory reads (stale version, nothing, invented); compare policies.

claim: Natural-language instructions (forget prompt, focus prompt, relevance meta-prompt) give under 10 points of gain against LLM PI; only a structural reset (mock QA turn) helps substantially.
agent_test: Compare prompt 'ignore old' vs archiving superseded items vs fresh-context re-presentation at equal tokens.

claim: Parameter scale predicts resistance to retroactive interference but declared context window does not; the scale effect on PI is disputed (R2=0.26 significant vs R2=0.06 not significant, different model sets and metrics).
agent_test: Not agent-controllable; only sets the expectation that a bigger context window does not buy interference resistance.

claim: In current LLMs proactive interference is harder than retroactive (39/39 models, mean gap 69.5 points), the reverse of the usual human pattern. Holds for GPT-5 (186.4 vs 99.2), o3 and Gemini-2.5-pro; Claude-4.5-opus nearly closes it (178.4 vs 170.3). Same-lab, one paradigm.
agent_test: Replicate on our model with paired RI/PI items; check which direction dominates in our agent memory.

claim: Longer items raise interference more than more updates or more keys: values of 10 words push accuracy below 40%, 40 words below 5%.
agent_test: Store short normalized entries vs verbose ones; test recall at equal token budgets.

claim: Reasoning models resist RI better (RIES 178.0 vs 150.3, d=1.76) but not PI: reasoning PI accuracy is 0 at N>=50 vs 53.6 and 10.9 for non-reasoning at N=50 and 100 (o1 RIES 186.4, PIES 22.0). Extra reasoning does not find the latest version.
agent_test: Test whether extra reasoning tokens before retrieval help find the newest version.

claim: In agents, adding every experience to memory degrades performance; strict selective addition plus deletion recovers or beats a fixed memory (EHRAgent accuracy 13.05 add-all vs 38.50 strict).
agent_test: Compare add-all, add-if-novel/good, and cap-per-class memory at equal tokens.

claim: Interference in agent memory depends on relationship, not count: repeated history and same-slot conflict cut plasticity (-0.34, -0.50 lexical) far more than unrelated additions (-0.02).
agent_test: Hold memory count fixed; vary relation (unrelated, near-duplicate, conflicting update) and measure.

claim: Deduplication can cut the store with little accuracy loss when moderate (70.1 vs 71.2 at 200K tokens M-tier), but aggressive consolidation hurts (48.4 vs 78.4 at S-tier).
agent_test: Dedup near-duplicates only above a similarity threshold; never merge conflicting updates; measure.

claim: Dating facts and questions shrinks the lookback drop (MINTEval: Full Context 13.22 to 5.48, RAG 31.43 to 10.45), but a bare date hint on evolving facts does not help (evolveQA, within about 1 to 4 points).
agent_test: Add version/timestamp tags to every memory entry; measure stale-answer rate.

claim: Outdated knowledge conflicts degrade answers: 23-54% outdated responses, accuracy drop 6-31% vs control; best model 55.2% on STALE.
agent_test: Add supersession links; test stale-vs-current answers.

claim: Distractors similar to the question hurt long-context performance beyond length alone; removing distractors or using focused prompts lifts accuracy.
agent_test: Compare full history vs only relevant parts at equal answer quality; strip distractors.

claim: INT4 quantization increases same-key intrusion errors under high interference (Qwen 81.0 to 68.3 accuracy); effect reverses with numeric distractors.
agent_test: Only relevant if we use quantized local models.

claim: Human PI builds over successive trials and is released by a category change; release is near-complete once retrieval processes are controlled (Baeuml and Kliegl 2013).
agent_test: Classify entries by category and cap per class; test recall when category rotates.

claim: Peterson and Peterson (1959) did not themselves show PI build-up in their own data (3-6 s accuracy rose .57 to .74); the PI account of short-term forgetting came from Keppel and Underwood (1962).
agent_test: Historical; do not use for design.

claim: Underwood (1957): forgetting depends on the number of previously learned lists; one-day forgetting ranged about 20% to nearly 80%.
agent_test: Cap similar prior entries per class; test recall vs number of prior similar lists.
audit: downgraded 2026-11-01 by check_established.py: only 1 opened source(s) from distinct authors

claim: The retroactive-interference time gradient is weak: Archer-Underwood and Newton-Wickens trends are marginal (F=2.83 p<.10; F=5.91 p<.05); spaced learning abolishes PI (Underwood and Ekstrand).
agent_test: Test whether spacing/interleaving different classes reduces interference.

claim: Interference is competition at retrieval, not erasure: unlearning predictions (spontaneous recovery on MMFR) fail; context-change models fit the data.
agent_test: Theory; practical consequence is that old items stay reachable by cues.

claim: Human PI loads left inferior frontal gyrus and is larger in older adults and frontal patients; directed-forgetting probes cost 136 ms.
agent_test: Not testable.

claim: Item familiarity modulates PI: repeating non-words show PI 0.19 vs unique non-words 0.06 (d=1.12).
agent_test: Novel vs repeated token patterns in memory keys.

claim: Instruction compliance falls under load (2-21%; terminal constraints up to 50%); salient formatting restores 90-100%.
agent_test: Place critical constraints last and salient; measure compliance.

claim: A tiny trained transformer with sleep-like consolidation holds 97% at PI depth 10 where baselines stay under 18%, but falls to 16.5% at depth 30.
agent_test: Training method; not applicable to a scaffold.

claim: Trained active context management (Sculptor) lifts PI-LLM sharply (13B 22.5 to 99.4 with RL); prompt-guided gain is modest (+5.9 Claude-4-Sonnet, none for DeepSeek-V3).
agent_test: Give the agent context edit/prune tools; measure at equal tokens.

claim: Retrieval quality dominates agent-memory errors: retrieval failure 11-46% vs utilization failure 4-8%; in multi-target interference the evidence is in the pool only 58.3% of the time.
agent_test: Measure retrieval hit rate and answer rate separately in our agent.

claim: Hiding superseded revisions from the memory view (archive kept) beats leaving all revisions active by 23.3, 33.3 and 23.0 points on three benchmarks at a fixed 2,048-token budget (one model).
agent_test: Compare keep-all-with-tags, hide-superseded, and delete-superseded at equal tokens on our memory.

claim: Related entries (repeated history, same-slot conflict) cut plasticity at 2 entries under lexical retrieval and then plateau (.84 to .50 and .34); under dense retrieval the loss keeps growing to 8 (same-slot stability .92 to .54). A cap of 2 to 4 per slot sits at the observed knee, but no cap arm was run.
agent_test: Run a cap sweep at 1,2,3,5,8 per class, lexical and dense, on real entries.

claim: Distractor pruning adds little for the largest current models (Opus 4.7 +0.008, GPT-5.5 +0.017 on BABILong) but helps smaller ones (Haiku 4.5 +0.083, Sonnet 4.6 +0.104). Caps may matter most for mid-size models.
agent_test: Check cap benefit per model size.

claim: Human release from PI grows with category distance (fruits to professions more than fruits to vegetables) and content shifts release more (91 percent) than time shifts (74 percent). Keppel and Underwood 1962: asymptote .99 on Trial 1, .58 on Trial 3. Numbers are second-hand.
agent_test: When rotating categories in memory, pick far classes.

claim: No study yet tests category-change release for LLMs or entry compression as a fix; search was incomplete (budget exhausted).
agent_test: Test labelled-category rotation and short normalized entries in-house.
